name: Parallel Ray Casting with Segment Lists
definition: Parallel rendering algorithm using OpenMP. Distributes image rows across MPI ranks and threads. Uses segment lists to skip empty space and calculates sampling points based on step length.
summary: Parallel Ray Casting with Segment Lists is a volume rendering acceleration method that skips empty space by iterating precomputed segment lists along rays, differing from ray compaction by retaining full ray structure.
